title: A Safehouse for the Extraction
author: Ivo Thornbury
blurb: Coral Galloway, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
